articles.title: Asian Games 2026 in Japan: India's Complete Multi-Sport Schedule From Cricket to Athletics

articles.title: From Post-Pregnancy Arthritis to CWG Bronze: Seema Kaliramna Eyes Asian Games Medal
articles.excerpt: The 27-year-old discus thrower from Haryana returned from severe arthritis after childbirth to win Commonwealth Games bronze, and now targets the Asian Games in Japan as a step toward the Olympics.
articles.nri_angle: Kaliramna's story of comeback through motherhood and arthritis resonates with diaspora audiences following Indian athletics ahead of the Asian Games.

articles.title: Delhi Capitals Owner Ends KL Rahul Trade Speculation Ahead of IPL 2027
articles.excerpt: Co-owner Parth Jindal declared 'we have unfinished business' after weeks of rumours linking the 34-year-old batter with Kolkata Knight Riders.

articles.title: Cricket Australia Opens Big Bash League to Private Investment Starting With Melbourne Renegades
articles.excerpt: The governing body will invite bids for the Renegades franchise from the 2027-28 season, opening the door for IPL owners and other investors despite opposition from New South Wales and Queensland.
articles.image_caption: A Big Bash League match. Cricket Australia has opened the league to private investment, starting with the Melbourne Renegades.
articles.nri_angle: IPL franchise groups could soon own stakes in BBL clubs, extending the Indian cricket economy's reach into Australia and connecting the two biggest cricket markets for diaspora fans.

articles.title: Mark Chapman Drops NZ Central Contract to Chase Big Bash League Opportunity
articles.excerpt: The New Zealand batter will play the white-ball series against India in November before heading to Australia for the BBL, while fast bowler Matt Fisher takes his spot on the full-time contract list.
articles.image_caption: New Zealand cricketer Mark Chapman has opted out of his central contract to pursue a Big Bash League opportunity in Australia.
articles.nri_angle: Chapman remains committed to the India series in November, a marquee fixture for cricket fans in the diaspora.

articles.title: Ashish Nehra Calls Gill and Pandya "North Pole and South Pole" as Captains
articles.excerpt: The Gujarat Titans head coach compared his two skippers' contrasting leadership styles, backing the reserved Shubman Gill to grow into India's captaincy while praising Hardik Pandya's openness and trust.
articles.image_caption: Indian cricketer Shubman Gill. Gujarat Titans head coach Ashish Nehra described Gill and Hardik Pandya as contrasting captaincy styles during a Cricket Association of Bengal awards ceremony.

articles.title: Karun Nair Walks Out of South Zone Duleep Trophy Camp, Scores Defiant Century
articles.excerpt: After being overlooked for both the semi-final and final, the veteran Karnataka batter left the squad and smashed 104 for KSCA Secretary XI, calling his exclusion "inexplicable."
articles.image_caption: Indian cricketer Karun Nair, who left the South Zone squad during the Duleep Trophy final and scored a defiant century in a KSCA tournament in Bengaluru.

articles.title: Salil Ankola's Journey: From Debuting With Tendulkar to Fighting a Bone Tumour and Severe Depression
articles.excerpt: The former Indian fast bowler, who played his only Test alongside a teenage Sachin Tendulkar, saw his career cut short by a shin tumour at 28 and has recently spoken about his battle with mental health.
articles.image_caption: Former India cricketer Salil Ankola, who made his Test debut alongside Sachin Tendulkar in 1989. He has spoken publicly about his battles with a bone tumour and severe depression.
articles.nri_angle: Ankola's openness about depression resonates with a broader conversation about mental health in the Indian diaspora and challenges the stigma that persists in cricket culture.

articles.title: Shafali Verma Rewrites Record Books as India Crush Pakistan in Women's Asia Cup
articles.excerpt: The 22-year-old opener becomes the youngest and fastest player to reach 3,000 Women's T20I runs during India's seven-wicket demolition of Pakistan in Dubai.

articles.title: India's Cricket Schedule, Squads and Draw for Asian Games 2026 in Japan
